How Cape Horn compares with the rest of Coquitlam

items.t: Houses in Cape Horn have the 16th highest median of 20 Coquitlam sub-areas, $1,332,500. Meadow Brook is lowest at $984,000 and Harbour Place highest at $2,000,000. Eagle Ridge CQ ($1,305,000) sits just below and Canyon Springs ($1,375,000) sits just above.
